result.description: Customer service and support platform: ticketing, help center, messaging, voice, live chat, sales CRM and AI agents.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 access tokens (Bearer) are preferred. Global OAuth is required for apps distributed to multiple customers. API tokens via Basic auth ({email}/token:{token}) are labelled deprecated.
result.access_detail: Developer docs point to a free 14-day trial account, with no credit card needed. No permanent free developer sandbox was verified. A sponsored-account page link returned 404. I could not confirm which plans include API access. Distributing a global OAuth client to many customers likely needs a Zendesk-side registration; I did not verify this.
result.api_notes: Multiple REST API families: Support/Ticketing (tickets, users, organizations, custom objects, workflows), Help Center, Voice, Live Chat, Sales CRM, Custom Data, Conversations/Messaging.
result.blocker: The trial account is time-limited. OAuth global-client setup is needed for multi-tenant use. API tokens are being phased out. No official, documented vendor MCP server was found.

evidence.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
Basic authentication is used for API tokens.
If you plan on making an app, integration, or bot available to multiple Zendesk customers, you must use global OAuth access tokens to authenticate Zendesk API requests.
Try out the Sunshine Platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
